knowledge_root.title: Knowledge root
knowledge_root.description: Overrides the run knowledge base location (default: ~/.claude/experiments/knowledge/). Accepted values: an absolute path, or a `~`-prefixed path; a relative value is rejected. Reaches the knowledge scripts verbatim as the KNOWLEDGE_ROOT environment variable — scripts/lib/knowledge.mjs's resolveKnowledgeRoot() is the only place that expands `~`, applies the default and validates the value. Leave empty to use the built-in default.
